scope: Source-anchored party identity and off-dungeon encounter observations. Party membership and encounter location are separate dimensions: sharing a party does not prove physical co-location, and sharing a media scene may be physical or holographic.
rules: Include a party or squad when it intersects the tracked cast or creates a meaningful split or merge in the narrative chart.
Do not import every named party from the wiki merely because it exists.
Retrospective party facts are revealed at the source anchor and are not backdated.
Off-dungeon media observations retain a mode so holograms are not presented as physical co-location.
